TC-10/S28.title: A 1,507-character Hospital pre-round through the live Save Note: labs, drugs, studies, tasks
TC-10/S28.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 43c38a4f deployed 2026-10-14 21:30Z), Quinn's dev session of 17:12 JST, agent unit through scripts/dev/run-unit(-plan).sh under runs/.dev.lock, run-id 2026-10-15-pre-dev; rows prefixed 'QA TC-10-Sxx ', deleted after (cleanup.json: 0 remaining, no other row changed, appMode restored). Unit P28 (new plan). The live model's extraction is good: Labs hold all 12 labs with their values; Diagnostic Testing holds the 3 dictated studies (plus 'Echocardiogram (Friday): planned' — the planned echo filed as a study, recorded); the one-liner names the drugs with doses. App failures confirmed with the live model: cp1 — Medications reads 'No medications recorded yet.' and none of the 7 drugs is stored (the dictated list is one sentence ending 'and acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours as needed'; the pre-round merge treats every drug of that sentence as mentioned only conditionally — see the local TC-10/S28 control); cp2 — the task list is empty: 'ask infectious disease about removing the PICC line' and 'book a repeat echocardiogram for Friday' (after character 1,200; only the first 1,200 characters go to task extraction) never become tasks. The unit's cp2 first failed only with 'scope not found' ('Tasks' / 'Note Format' are plain text, not headings); re-judged with the same oracle and the anchors fixed (P28.scopefix.*) it fails on the two missing tasks.
TC-10/S28.productIssue: With the live model: a medication list dictated in one sentence that ends with an 'as needed' drug leaves the Medications panel and tracker empty, and plan items after the first 1,200 characters of a long pre-round never become tasks.
